# Copilot Instructions

This repository is in the concept and planning stage. README.md defines the project vision, but there is no application source code, package manifest, test suite, or lint configuration.

- Treat README.md capabilities, architecture, technology choices, and project structure as proposed, not implemented or finalized.
- Do not assume a programming language, framework, package manager, build command, test runner, or lint command.
- Before making implementation changes, inspect the files introduced with the project and use their declared tooling and conventions.
- Add build, test, lint, architecture, and project-specific convention guidance here once the initial project structure is established.
